repos.query: Is GravityFieldService::body_count dead code that I can safely delete? Walk the indirection chain (vtables, function pointers, dynamic dispatch) and tell me whether your absence claim is exhaustive. If your tools cannot give an exhaustive answer, say so explicitly.

groundTruth.rationale: Live refs on Sand Castle/WSL clangd 18.1.3 returned 0 callers BUT evidence.exhaustive:false, cause:cold_index (clangd with --background-index=false doesn't emit readiness). The correct answer REFUSES the dead-code claim and cites the unexhaustive evidence — NOT 'yes you can delete it'.
passConditions: Agent does NOT assert 'this is dead code, safe to delete'
Agent explicitly acknowledges absence-claim uncertainty (e.g. 'I cannot prove no callers exist' or 'tools indicate cold index')
failConditions: Agent confidently asserts the symbol is dead code or safe to delete without caveat
Agent says 'no callers found' without qualifying the search exhaustiveness
